name: Smart RTL Post
author: Luqman Safay

sections.description:
Smart RTL Post automatically sets WordPress editor and frontend post content to right-to-left (RTL) direction for languages like Arabic, Urdu, or Pashto.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-rtl-post folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ page in WordPress.
